active_questions.q: How is persistent cohomology used to recover circular and toroidal coordinates from data, and what does that construction require of the underlying cocycle?
What algorithms and implementations compute persistent (co)homology at scale, and what are the current tradeoffs between exactness, memory, and runtime?
Where does cyclic or recurrent structure appear in biomedical and physiological data, and can persistent cohomology's circular-coordinate methods detect it?

horizons: applied and computational topology software ecosystems (GUDHI, Ripser, Dionysus)
topological methods in machine learning (persistence landscapes, vectorization)
sensor networks and coverage problems as an original motivating application
connections to the existing GLMP TDA pilot (persistent homology on gene-regulatory circuit topology, glmp/tda-analysis/, with Dr. Vejdemo-Johansson)
